plan.search_reasoning: Haiti's cholera surveillance is primarily reported through MSPP (Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Population), WHO/PAHO situation reports, UNICEF/OCHA humanitarian updates, and ProMED/ReliefWeb. The time window (Q4 2024) is recent enough that peer-reviewed literature is unlikely to have indexed it yet, so priority goes to official agency reports, international organization dashboards, and news/situation reports. Two languages are critical: English (WHO, PAHO, ReliefWeb, news) and French/Haitian Creole (MSPP, local media). Upstream queries used overly rigid exact-phrase matching with date-range strings embedded in the query text, which may suppress results. This iteration refines queries to be more natural and targeted, uses site-scoped searches for high-value domains (WHO, PAHO, MSPP, ReliefWeb), and adds a structured-database query for WHO GHO / Global Cholera Dashboard. The 4-query cap per iteration forces prioritization: (1) WHO/PAHO official site search in English, (2) French-language MSPP/PAHO search, (3) ReliefWeb/OCHA humanitarian situation report search, (4) WHO Global Cholera Dashboard / structured data search. These four cover the highest-yield source types within the bounds.

decision.decision_reason: Iteration 1 returned 28 accepted candidates from authoritative domains (who.int, paho.org, reliefweb.int), and one snippet (WHO multi-country sitrep #22) directly references Haiti's full-year 2024 figure (10,556 cases, 162 deaths through 29 December 2024), which partially covers the Q4 2024 window. However, critical gaps remain: (1) No Q4-specific (October–December 2024) subnational/departmental breakdowns have been confirmed in the metadata — most retrieved documents are dated pre-Q4 2024 (March–April 2024 sitreps, April 2024 epi updates) or post-window (2025 sitreps); (2) MSPP weekly bulletins for epi weeks 40–52 of 2024 have not been surfaced; (3) UNICEF/OCHA humanitarian situation reports specifically covering Q4 2024 are absent from the top results; (4) ProMED and HDX structured datasets for Q4 2024 have not appeared; (5) News sources corroborating Q4 2024 figures are missing. The WHO sitrep #22 snippet is the only confirmed in-window aggregate, but subnational, weekly, and hospitalization data for Q4 2024 remain uncovered. A second iteration is warranted to close these gaps within the 2-iteration, 4-query-per-iteration bound.
decision.coverage_assessment: Partial. One WHO document (sitrep #22, published 2025-01-10) provides a full-year 2024 aggregate for Haiti (10,556 cases, 162 deaths through 29 Dec 2024), which spans the Q4 window but does not isolate Q4-specific figures or subnational breakdowns. All other top results are either pre-Q4 2024 (March–May 2024 sitreps) or post-window (2025 sitreps). ReliefWeb results returned are from 2014 and 2025, not Q4 2024. MSPP bulletins for epi weeks 40–52/2024 are absent. UNICEF Q4 2024 humanitarian situation reports are absent. Hospitalization data for Q4 2024 is not confirmed. Subnational (département) data for Q4 2024 is not confirmed.
decision.source_diversity_assessment: Iteration 1 covered WHO, PAHO, ReliefWeb, and general web. Missing source types for Q4 2024: (1) MSPP direct bulletins (mspp.gouv.ht), (2) UNICEF Haiti situation reports Q4 2024, (3) ProMED cholera Haiti alerts Q4 2024, (4) HDX/structured dataset entries for Q4 2024, (5) news sources (AP, Reuters, Le Nouvelliste) corroborating Q4 2024 figures. Facebook and YouTube results are low-value and not Haiti-specific. BEACON results reference 2025 data. The ReliefWeb result is from 2014. Source diversity for the target time window is insufficient.
decision.trustworthiness_assessment: The WHO multi-country sitrep #22 (who.int) is the highest-trust result and directly relevant to the task window. PAHO documents are authoritative but pre-Q4 2024. IRIS PAHO sitrep #8 is from March 2024. The ReliefWeb result is from 2014 and irrelevant. Facebook (Malawi MoH) is off-topic. BEACON references 2025 data. The PAHO French sitrep is from August 2025. Overall, only 1 of 10 top results is confirmed in-window and authoritative. Trust is adequate for that one result but the broader result set has significant temporal mismatch.
decision.disease_location_time_fit_assessment: Disease fit: Strong (cholera confirmed across results). Location fit: Strong (Haiti confirmed). Time fit: Weak — only 1 result (WHO sitrep #22) is confirmed to cover the Q4 2024 window, and it provides only a full-year aggregate, not Q4-isolated figures. Most other results are from outside the 2024-10-01 to 2024-12-31 window. A targeted second iteration is needed to surface Q4-specific documents.
decision.corroboration_potential_assessment: The WHO sitrep #22 figure (10,556 cases, 162 deaths for full-year 2024) needs corroboration from PAHO Q4-specific sitreps, MSPP bulletins, and UNICEF/OCHA Q4 2024 reports. Subnational figures require MSPP or PAHO Haiti health cluster sitreps from epi weeks 40–52/2024. A second iteration targeting these specific document types and time windows will substantially improve corroboration potential.

Haiti is experiencing a resurgence of cholera, with the outbreak initially reported on 2 October 2022 after more than three years with no reported cases of cholera, evolving rapidly, and spreading to all parts of the country.
